title: Just reworked the UI and on screen elements for my rpg. Thoughts on this lay out?
author: dank_summers
selftext: Also just added this staff and it's magic abilities, how is the vfx looking on the attacks?

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Just restricting my thoughts to the UI: 

It's all quite well laid-out and very legible, IMHO, with the exception of the Satchel, Stats, Map and Options buttons. I would find somewhere else for those to go. Probably the Options button just needs to be in the Esc menu, while Stats and Satchel belong in whatever your character screen menu is. 

Aesthetically it is not very nice looking.

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body:
Yeah I can agree the right side is heavy and makes it look un balanced. Had very placeholdery generic Ai looking UI prior to this, so my 1st pass at making it unique and for the cave monkey aesthetic.

What do you think I could do to improve the look?

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body: Would also love to hear any other thought you have in general.

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: It’s not too bad. I’d personally stop the minimap from rotating and instead have a little directional indicator of what way the player is traveling

replies.author: dank_summers
replies.body: I wasn't too happy with how the stone wheel was looking so I'm keeping the same idea but completely redoing it currently haha. That's a solid point raised about the minimap and makes sense, I'll see how that looks in this pass
